gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.knop.uitl: Choose who lives in this family: a parent or a little one for each animal (and for some species a male or a female). Who changes is swapped with a puff; there are always four.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.uitleg: Choose for each animal whether it is a parent or a little one. With the %s, males and females look the same.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.uitleg.ge: Choose for each animal whether it is a parent or a little one, and whether a parent is a male or a female: with the %s you can see the difference.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.ouder_kin: Click to switch between a parent (grown-up) and a little one.
Click to switch between a male and a female. With this species you can see the difference.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.wissel: Who you change is swapped with a puff. Its name stays.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.klaar.uit: The family is put together like this. Who changes is swapped; there are always four.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.annuleren: Back to the sign; the family stays as it is. You can always change it later with Put the family together on the Family tab.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.reden.gee: There has to be at least one parent in the family.
gui.guhs.verblijf.samenstellen.ongeldig: That can't be: a family has at least one parent.
